'''Kyaka''' (Enga-Kyaka) is an [[Engan language]] of the East New Guinea Highlands in [[Enga Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]].<ref>Draper, Norm and Sheila Draper. 2002. ''Dictionary of Kyaka Enga, Papua New Guinea''. Canberra: Pacific Linguistics.</ref>
